notes: 0.4.50 — SharkEYE dashcam (v1): records Front+Rear or 4-way to looping 3-minute MP4 clips on a USB drive, auto-deleting the oldest to make room, with lock-to-keep. Live preview when parked, frozen while recording to save CPU. Steps aside cleanly whenever the car uses the cameras. Turn it on in Settings → System → SharkEYE dashcam.
